from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u076/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ff616c6f.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separators = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            separators.add(("r", r, row[0]))
    for c in range(w):
        col = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(col)) == 1:
            separators.add(("c", c, col[0]))
    row_seps = {i for axis, i, _ in separators if axis == "r"}
    col_seps = {i for axis, i, _ in separators if axis == "c"}
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out, start = [], 0
        for i in sorted(cuts):
            if start < i:
                out.append((start, i))
            start = i + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append((start, n))
        return out
    rs, cs = spans(h, row_seps), spans(w, col_seps)
    rooms = [[ [grid[r][c] for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y)] for x,y in cs] for a,b in rs]
    colors = [v for roomrow in rooms for room in roomrow for v in room if v != 5]
    base = max(set(colors), key=colors.count)
    return [[1 if room.count(5) != 1 else base for room in roomrow] for roomrow in rooms]
'''
p.write_text(source)
